thread:
maria: Heads up — threat intel just CONFIRMED an exploited-in-the-wild vulnerability: CVE-2029-0456 in yaml-cpp (deserialization RCE). Attacker IOCs attached to the report link: https://intel.example.com/CVE-2029-0456 :warning:
rahul: link received. key detail: exploit targets YAML tags with `!!` polymorphic deserialization. Several open-source tools we ship (model-importer, config-loader) pull untrusted manifests.
samir: creating incident ticket INC-2029-0456 and paging oncall. @ops please triage live traffic.
jen: quick impact calc: model-import pipeline (model-importer), infra-config service, and deploy-agent all parse user-submitted YAML. Fast estimate: ~12 internal services, 3 customer-facing endpoints.
taylor: immediate mitigations we can push now:
- block YAML payloads at edge (WAF rule to drop requests with `!!` or suspicious tags)
- flip env var to disable YAML parsing where possible: `USE_YAML=false`
- tighten ingress rate limits for model-import endpoints

Example grep to find occurrences:
```
# repo-root
grep -R "yaml-cpp" --include="*.cpp" --include="*.cc" || true
# or for python callers
rg "yaml.load|yaml.FullLoader|yaml.unsafe_load" -S || true
```

Example quick disable for the node service (canary):
```
# in k8s manifest
env:
  - name: USE_YAML
    value: "false"
```

devops-bot: deploy pipeline triggered for canary patch to model-importer (pipeline/patch-1799401234) :rocket:
security-lead: Routing note: prioritize patch for dedicated infra first, then hosted API. Also: initiate KMS audit and consider rotating any keys that private ingestion service SAs can access. We should capture key usage logs immediately.
ops: starting canary rollout to us-west-2 now. ETA 25m for initial canary. Will apply WAF rule globally after canary verification.
pm: I'll draft a customer advisory template: short summary, affected surfaces, mitigations customers can apply (disable YAML imports, rotate keys), expected timelines.
andy: RBAC change: create dedicated least-privilege SA for ingestion that has NO KMS decrypt permissions and swap services to use that where feasible. I'll open a PR to infra-iam and target a fast rollout.
jen: patch plan for deps: bump yaml-cpp to vendor-fixed 0.7.3+patched in our build manifests. For python libs, replace unsafe_load with safe_load and add schema validation.
rahul: commands to find vulnerable pinning in monorepo:
```
# java/maven
rg "<artifactId>yaml-cpp|library: yaml-cpp" -S || true
# conan/cmake
rg "yaml-cpp/" -S || true
```

maria: owner assignments:
- triage & canary: ops (assigned)
- dependency upgrades: jen + eng-runtime (assigned)
- RBAC & KMS audit: andy + security-lead (assigned)
- comms: pm (assigned)

security-lead: also enable audit logging on KMS for the next 72h and tag logs `CVE-2029-0456` for fast querying. Set alert for unusual decrypt volume.
ops: can confirm canary healthy at +22m, no regressions so far. Moving to staged rollout to dedicated capacity.
jen: pushing dependency PRs with the patched yaml-cpp and python safe_load fixes. Will include automated tests for document schema validation.
pm: customer advisory draft ready in #security-comms — posting for review. Short blurb, recommended actions, link to status page.
andy: submitted infra-iam PR to create `svc-ingest-no-kms` and policy to block `cloudkms.cryptoKeys.decrypt`. Requesting review.
rahul: added IPS signatures and YARA rule to internal detection for the exploit payloads.
security-lead: recommend rotating any ephemeral credentials rotated today and schedule KMS key rotation for affected keys in the next maintenance window if we can't prove no exposure.
devops-bot: canary->staged rollout completed. No anomalies.
maria: summary/next steps: 1) WAF rule deployed 2) canary and staged rollouts applied 3) dep PRs open for rollback/patch 4) RBAC change in PR 5) KMS audit & rotate plan initiated 6) customer advisory posted.
ops: moving to full global rollout now. ETA 40m.
jen: will land backports for pinned older releases (v1.2.x, v1.3.x) after CI passes.
pm: comms schedule: post initial advisory, follow-up 4h, final resolution after full rollout.
security-lead: logging: capture `kubectl logs -l app=model-importer --since=1h` and attach to incident. Also dump audit logs to the incident ticket.
maria: closing loop — anyone not assigned but wants to help ping me directly. Great work, team. :white_check_mark:
ops: noted. Will update INC-2029-0456 with rollout checkpoints and ETA for closure.
jen: PRs merged to main and backports opened. Running regression tests.
security-lead: post-mortem owners: eng-runtime + security. We'll schedule RCA meeting tomorrow.
samir: incident updated: severity P1 -> P2 after mitigations, keeping incident open until global rollout + backports complete.
maria: thanks all. I'll prepare exec note once we have final verification. :eyes:
